alex: Heads up — p95 latency spike on model redwood/text-small in us-west1 started ~20:12 UTC. Dashboard shows prefix cache hit-rate drop from ~92% -> ~11% coincident with a rolling deploy. :eyes:

vijay: saw the alert. which deploy rolled around that time?

alex: deploy id deploy-2026-03-17T20:10 (rolling). feature flag enable_dynamic_batching_v2=true in the same window.

perf-bot: snapshot metrics: cpu=13%, gpu=61%, kv_prefix_hitrate=11%, prefix_evictions=+180k (10m). logs bucket: gs://redwood-perf/snapshots/2059876543-20-12.tar.gz

lisa: note — PR #4124 (kernel_autoselect heuristic tweak) merged 20:09 and shipped with the roll. could change kernel choices for short sequences.

chris: timeline double-check — batching_v2 (PR#4101) at 20:08, kernel-autoselect tweak (PR#4124) at 20:09, rollout completed 20:11.

vijay: can someone grep runtime logs for chosen_kernel and batch_size in 20:05-20:15 window?

alex: quick grep command I used: ```journalctl -u runtime | grep -E "2026-03-17T20:(0[5-9]|1[0-9])" | egrep "chosen_kernel|batch_size|kv_eviction"``` — ~12k lines; attaching top matches.

lisa: profiler summary (10m window): p50 ~42ms, p95 jumped to ~220ms, p99 ~480ms. cluster throughput down ~18%.

chris: logs show many requests switched to small_seq_kernel_v2 instead of small_seq_kernel_v1. kernel_v2 increases per-request working set (mem) -> more KV cache churn and evictions.

vijay: that matches: KV eviction surge explains the prefix miss storm and latency tail.

alex: hypothesis: kernel_autoselect now biases toward v2 when batch_size==1 under new heuristics; dynamic batching increased number of requests hitting the size-1 path, amplifying the effect.

lisa: repro plan: flip kernel_autoselect to false on a canary host and observe kv_hitrate and latency before broader rollback.

chris: I can patch a single pod in us-west1 to set kernel_autoselect=false. @alex want me to do it?

alex: please. command I used: ```kubectl patch deployment runtime -n prod -p '{"spec":{"template":{"metadata":{"annotations":{"kernel_autoselect":"false-canary"}}}}}'``` — done for one replica.

perf-bot: canary metrics (90s after patch): kv_prefix_hitrate -> 76%, p95 -> 48ms. :thumbsup:

vijay: nice. suggest we stage rollback cluster-wide but keep batching_v2 disabled until we validate kernel_v2 quantization/memory profile.

lisa: also adding a dashboard tile: histogram chosen_kernel vs prefix_hitrate and a gating metric for future kernel changes.

chris: scheduling rollback: rolling update to set kernel_autoselect=false for all replicas, start 21:02 UTC.

alex: post-rollback summary: kv_prefix_hitrate recovered to ~88% cluster-wide, p95 down to ~46ms, throughput back to expected.

vijay: follow-ups (action items): 1) revert kernel-autoselect heuristic change in PR#4124, 2) add guard to avoid switching kernels for batch_size<=1, 3) add a preflight check for batching_v2 that measures kv_hitrate/regression risk.

lisa: filing perf ticket INF-2391 with traces, pprof captures, and profiling artifacts. link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-2391

alex: thanks team — nice rapid rollback and telemetry. we'll also add a CI perf gate for kernel selection changes. :tada:
